major_cooldowns.name: Ascendance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it a couple of globals into the pull, then fill every global with Crash Lightning when it is ready and Windstrike otherwise while Thorim's Invocation does your Maelstrom Weapon spending.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 114051 is the Air Ascendant cast the parses show (5/5, 22 casts). Table base_cd_s is 180; the guide states Thorim's Invocation, always taken with this node, cuts it to 120s.

major_cooldowns.name: Doom Winds
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it off the GCD in the same global as Primordial Storm or Crash Lightning, keep it lined up with Surging Totem, and then fill the window with main hand strikes.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 384352 is the castable id per its tooltip. The sampled parses run the Ascendance side of the choice node, so they only carry 469270 (the periodic strike) and the 466772 self aura from Ascendance triggered Doom Winds.

major_cooldowns.name: Sundering
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown straight after Surging Totem so Whirling Earth is consumed and the Surging Elements haste lands over your burst window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses, which take neither Surging Elements nor Feral Spirit, but castable per its tooltip.

major_cooldowns.name: Surging Totem
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it every minute and follow with Sundering, then Lava Lash, so Whirling Fire and Primal Catalyst start a long Hot Hand.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base_cd_s is 25, which is the totem duration; the guide states the cooldown is one minute. Totemic only, not pressed in the sampled Stormbringer parses but castable per its tooltip.

major_cooldowns.name: Primordial Storm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it at full Maelstrom Weapon inside every Doom Winds window so all three of its strikes roll Windfury.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1218090 is the attack itself; the guide links 1218047, which the table shows as the 15s talent buff. NOT observed in the sampled parses, which run Stormbringer, but the guide describes it as a pressed button in the Totemic sequence. Cadence follows its Sundering gate rather than a listed cooldown.

rule.description: Voltaic Blaze then Stormstrike into Ascendance
rule.action: Apply Flame Shock with Voltaic Blaze and take one Stormstrike for starting Maelstrom Weapon before you press Ascendance.

rule.description: Spend Maelstrom Weapon at full stacks
rule.action: Pool Maelstrom Weapon to full before you press Lightning Bolt, and let Thorim's Invocation do the spending inside your cooldown windows.

rule.description: Windstrike is your filler during Ascendance
rule.action: Chain Windstrike on every global you are not spending on Crash Lightning or Voltaic Blaze, and leave Lava Lash until the window ends.

rule.description: Keep the Crash Lightning buff rolling
rule.action: Recast Crash Lightning as soon as its cleave buff drops so your strikes keep splashing.

rule.description: Keep Flame Shock on your target
rule.action: Reapply it with Voltaic Blaze the moment it falls off, or hard cast Flame Shock when Voltaic Blaze is down.

rule.description: Chain Lightning is your AoE Maelstrom spender
rule.action: Spend on Lightning Bolt while a single enemy is up and swap to Chain Lightning once the pack lands.
